subject: Clarification request: vulnerability management artifacts, patch SLAs, and SBOM
messages:
From: Tom Hargrove <tom.hargrove@summitone.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: SummitOne Security <security@summitone.com>, Alyssa Reed <alyssa.reed@summitone.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarification request: VM artifacts for RFP (SAST/DAST, SBOM, patch SLAs, pen test)

Marissa,

Thanks for the packet you sent with the RFP. The review team at SummitOne had a few follow-ups specific to vulnerability management that we need to close out before the procurement committee can move forward. Can you confirm or provide the following items?

1) SAST/DAST coverage: what tools do you run in CI and pre-release for customer-facing inference code and prompt-handling services? Please include cadence (per-PR, nightly), approximate % code coverage of critical modules, and whether SAST rules include third-party dependency checks.

2) Patch SLAs: we need your documented SLAs for security patching. Specifically we are evaluating: Critical/High/Medium classification, time-to-patch target windows (e.g., 7/30/90 days), and whether you perform automated dependency patching (libraries/container base images). Also, how are emergency hotfixes handled?

3) Pen test summary: a redacted executive summary of the most recent external penetration test (date, major findings, remediation status and dates). A one-page summary is fine. We understand raw reports may be confidential; redactions are acceptable.

4) SBOM: requested format and component classification. We require an SBOM export (CSV or CycloneDX) with license and version fields. Also indicate whether you instrument dependency monitoring to flag CVEs automatically.

5) Evidence timeline: how quickly can you deliver the artifacts (redacted pen test summary, SBOM snapshot, and patch SLA matrix)? We are working on a compliance cutoff of July 2.

If you prefer, we can take a short call to walk the items rather than exchange files. Appreciate a reply by EOD Wednesday so the security committee can slot you for review.

Thanks,

Tom Hargrove
Head of Security Programs
SummitOne

---
Attachments: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Ben / Steph — forwarding SummitOne's items below. They want SBOM, redacted pen test executive summary, and our patch SLA matrix by July 2. They explicitly asked about SAST/DAST tooling and coverage.

Can you do the following?
- Ben: pull the latest SBOM export (CSV) and the patch_sla_matrix_q2_2026.xlsx we keep in the compliance drive. Confirm whether our dependency monitoring flags CVEs into PagerDuty or only Jira.
- Steph: coordinate with AppSec (Alejandro) to produce a one-page redacted pen test executive summary with dates and remediation status. Highlight that high findings were closed within our emergency remediation window and include the remediation ticket references.

I'll draft the email back to Tom once we have the artifacts. Keep answers short — they prefer the concise Q&A style. Put any sensitive excerpts into the secure Drive link and mark the link as view-only.

Marissa
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Alejandro Perez <alejandro.perez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 10:15:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Clarification request: VM artifacts for RFP (SummitOne)

Marissa / Steph —
Quick update on status and what I'll attach to the reply:

1) SBOM: I exported the SBOM snapshot for the inference runtime and control-plane services. File: redwood_sbom_202606.csv (CSV; columns: package, version, license, origin). We will redact internal build tags as requested.

2) Patch SLAs: pulling the matrix now (patch_sla_matrix_q2_2026.xlsx). TL;DR: Critical = 7 days (emergency hotfix path with 24–72h mitigation if customer-facing exploit), High = 30 days, Medium = 90 days for non-exploitable dev-deps. We will include notes on container base image patch cadence (weekly automated rebuilds) and scheduled OS image refreshes. We also run Dependabot-style dependency PRs daily and triage via AppSec.

3) SAST/DAST: SAST runs on every PR (static analysis with Coverity + custom rules) and nightly full-scan across main branches. DAST is executed on staging every release candidate using Burp Suite Pro and custom scenario test harnesses; we have instrumentation to capture request traces for triage. Coverage: critical modules (auth, model-serving, input handling) are covered by ~85–92% unit/test coverage and SAST rules targeted at those directories.

4) Pen test summary: Alejandro will provide the one-page redacted exec summary (external pen test completed 2025-11-18; high findings fixed by 2025-12-05). He'll include remediation ticket IDs for our internal tracker but redact any PII.

I'll stage the three files on our secure drive and share a view-only link. Anything else to call out in the reply?

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hargrove <tom.hargrove@summitone.com>
Cc: SummitOne Security <security@summitone.com>, Alyssa Reed <alyssa.reed@summitone.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Clarification request: VM artifacts for RFP (SAST/DAST, patch SLAs, pen test, SBOM)

Tom / SummitOne team —

Thanks for the clear list. Per your ask, attached are the packaged artifacts and a short clarifying note for each item. We aimed for concise answers so your committee can slot us quickly.

Attachments (view-only link & files):
- redwood_sbom_202606.csv (SBOM snapshot for runtime + control plane; columns: package, version, license, origin)
- redwood_pen_test_summary_2025_redacted.pdf (one-page exec summary: test date, scope, top findings, remediation status and ticket refs; redacted sensitive details)
- patch_sla_matrix_q2_2026.xlsx (documented SLA windows and emergency hotfix flow)

Quick clarifications:
- SAST/DAST: SAST runs on every PR (Coverity + custom rule set), nightly full SAST scan on main branches; DAST on staging per RC using Burp + scenario harnesses. We target ~85–92% coverage for critical directories and SAST rules include dependency scanning for known vulnerable components.

- Patch SLAs: Critical = 7 days (emergency process includes triage + hotfix and mitigation path within 24–72 hours for customer-impacting exploits), High = 30 days, Medium = 90 days. Container base image and OS patches are rebuilt weekly; dependency PRs are raised daily and triaged by AppSec.

- Pen test: most recent external pen test completed 2025-11-18; high and critical findings were remediated by 2025-12-05. The attached exec summary contains remediation ticket references (redacted where necessary).

- SBOM & monitoring: SBOM provided as CSV export; we feed dependency metadata into our monitoring pipeline which flags CVEs and creates PagerDuty alerts for critical CVEs affecting customer-impacting services.

Delivery timeline: the artifacts above were staged to a secure view-only Drive link and should satisfy the compliance cutoff you mentioned. If you need an NDA in place for the raw report, confirm and we will route through Legal.

If helpful I can set a 30-minute sync with Alejandro (AppSec) and Ben to walk the committee through the items.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
